name: sqlsourcereader-batch-relative-positions
body: Read parses each batch on its own text, so every TSqlFragment position is batch-relative: a file line is Batch.StartLine + fragment line - 1, and a file offset is Batch.StartOffset + fragment offset, where StartOffset is a .NET UTF-16 character index, not a UTF-8 byte offset. Callers that emit file spans convert to UTF-8 bytes themselves. Upgrade to file-relative fragments (e.g. padding each batch with the preceding text) only if the callers' offset arithmetic proves error-prone; the padding costs time quadratic in the batch count.
